question: Which of the following countries hosted the 13th edition of the 2020 ICC Under 19 Cricket World Cup?
solution:
The correct answer is __**South Africa.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The ICC U19 Cricket World Cup 2020 held in South Africa.
 
• Bangladesh won the ICC U19 Cricket World Cup 2020.
 
• 2018 ICC under-19 cricket world cup was held in New Zealand.
 
• India won the 2018 ICC Under-19 Cricket World Cup.
 
• Australia was the Runner up of the 2018 ICC under-19.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The ICC Under-19 Cricket World Cup is an international cricket tournament organized by the International Cricket Council (ICC).
 
• It is contested by national under-19 teams.
 
• The first edition was held in 1988, as the Youth World Cup.
 
• It was not staged again until 1998. Since then, the World Cup has been held as a biennial event.
 
• India has won the World Cup on a record 5th times and India is the most successful team.
